subject: exp-dy
title: EXP.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in WAC-27, the first of three on book p229. EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality). Embedded in the Euro-American discussion where Braxton argues that 'the dynamic solidification of Euro-American western art music must be viewed with respect to what it posed for the western affinity insight principle' — i.e., when European-trained composers in America had no traditional basis to draw from, expansion dynamics had to find a different route through social reality. Two upstream feeds: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) → HI-P (high purpose) → EXP-DYM, and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) → EXP-DYM. EXP-DYM outputs to SOC-RT (the crossing), INFO-DS (information dissemination), POL-DYM (political dynamics), and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). (C)DEF (the concept of definition) feeds INFO-DS, and INFO-DS → AFL-DT (affinity dictates). Structural argument: expansion dynamics is constituted by spiritual-dynamics-via-high-purpose plus accelerated functionalism — *requiring* a spiritual-purpose component that western culture, per Braxton, has structurally lost. Its outputs (social reality, information dissemination, political dynamics, progressional continuance) constitute the entire field of cultural reception. The (c)definition→information-dissemination→affinity-dictates side chain shows how *concepts of definition* (Braxton's diagram-coded conceptual reading) feed dissemination only by producing affinity dictates downstream — not by producing expansion dynamics directly.
